headline: Quiet Sunday closes a darker month
body: Another day without scored news. Lines drifted by a few hundredths as earlier stories faded, and Horizon Balance holds at -3.55. The month ends with Enslaved God on 37.32, Conquerors on 23.83 and Self-Destruction on 23.69.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.08 and Conquerors -0.07.
